course.title: Power Plant Engineering
course.department: Department of Energy Science and Engineering

content.value:
. A power station has a daily load cycle as follows: 11   
300 MW for 8 hours; 150 MW for 6 hours; 130 MW for 3 hours; 100 MW for 7 hours. If   
the power station is equipped with 2 sets of 200 MW each, calculate (i) daily load factor,   
(ii) plant capacity factor, and (iii) daily requirement of fuel if the calorific value of the   
fuel were 10,000 kcal/kg and the average heat rate of station were 25,000 kcal/kWh.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
